title: access_data_analysis_nf pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the Voyager-prepared samplesheet provided with params.input. One row per sample; all file paths are resolved by Voyager.

combined_id.description: Combined patient identifier used to group samples (e.g. C-ABC123_P-0012345)

cmo_patient_id.errorMessage: cmo_patient_id must be empty or follow the format 'C-XXXXXX'

dmp_patient_id.errorMessage: dmp_patient_id must be empty or follow the format 'P-XXXXXX'

assay_type.errorMessage: assay_type must be one of research_access, clinical_access, clinical_impact

anon_id.description: Anonymized ID for clinical samples ('NA' or empty for research samples)

access_version.description: ACCESS assay version for research samples; selects the v1/v2 gene list in copy-number filtering

duplex_bam.description: Path to the duplex BAM (research/clinical ACCESS tumor samples)

simplex_bam.description: Path to the simplex BAM (research/clinical ACCESS tumor samples)

unfilter_bam.description: Path to the unfiltered ACCESS BAM (research/clinical ACCESS normal samples)

standard_bam.description: Path to the standard BAM. Required for every sample: used by biometrics and by genotyping for clinical IMPACT.

maf.description: Path to the research mutations MAF (research ACCESS tumor samples only)

cna_file.description: Path to the research copy-number segments file (research ACCESS tumor samples only)

sv_file.description: Path to the research structural-variant file (research ACCESS tumor samples only)

msi_file.description: Path to the research MSI results file (research ACCESS tumor samples only)
